Container.Name: Communarr
Container.Overview: Communarr: a closed community place for you and your friends. A front page with everyone's posts and news, a forum, chat rooms (open or private) with voice chat in every room, a calendar with RSVPs and reminders, polls, groups, site-wide search, push notifications on phones, and 98 colour schemes plus your own themes with your own backgrounds. Invite-only; everything lives in one folder (appdata).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the website. Put your reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Cloudflare Tunnel...) in front of it: phones need HTTPS for push notifications and voice chat.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database, uploaded pictures and backups. Back this up (the Appdata Backup plugin does).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address your friends use, e.g. https://communarr.example.com. Used for invite links and calendar feeds behind a proxy.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: For event reminders, birthdays and calendar files.

Config.Name: TURN server
Config.Description: Optional: a TURN server for voice chat (e.g. turn:turn.example.com:3478), so phones on mobile data can talk too. Can also be set under Admin → Notifications & voice.

Config.Name: SMTP server
Config.Description: Optional: a mail server for forgotten passwords and notifications by mail (e.g. smtp.gmail.com). Can also be set under Admin → Mail, which wins.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for TLS, 25 for a relay on your own network.

Config.Name: SMTP username
Config.Description: The mail server's username (empty: no log-in).

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: The mail server's password (Gmail: an app password).

Config.Name: Mail sender
Config.Description: The address mails come from, e.g. noreply@example.com.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id Communarr runs as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for files Communarr creates.
